name: Balanced-Load Minimized-Communication Assignment (BLMCA)
definition: Considers both communication volume in RSM and load imbalance in LPM. MCA solves the communication objective; load balancing corresponds to the n-way number-partitioning problem (NP-hard). Uses Best-Fit Decreasing (BFD) heuristic from bin-packing.
summary: BLMCA is a load-balanced cell assignment method for tiled parallel volume rendering that minimizes inter-processor communication by prioritizing heavily loaded mesh-cells.
